tools.name: get_trending_terms
tools.description: Returns google trends for a specific geo location.

geo.description:
Geographic target for trending terms. Supports four levels of granularity:
- Worldwide: empty string ''
- Country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. 'US', 'GB', 'CA'
- Subdivision (state/province/region): ISO 3166-2 format 'CC-XX' or 'CC-XXX', e.g. 'US-CA' (California), 'BE-BRU' (Brussels)
- US metro area: bare Nielsen DMA code (numeric string), e.g. '807' (San Francisco Bay Area), '501' (New York City)

full_data.description: Return full data for each trend including related news stories.

tools.name: get_trends
tools.description: Pull search interest over time for keywords.

source.description: Search source: 'google search', 'youtube search', 'news search', 'image search', 'google shopping'.

data_mode.description: Legacy resolution hint used only when timeframe is omitted: 'weekly', 'daily', 'monthly'.

timeframe.description: Explicit TrendsPy range, for example 'today 12-m', 'today 90-d', 'all', or 'YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD'. Overrides data_mode when supplied.

cat.description: Google Trends category ID; use 0 for all categories or a value from get_categories.
